outcome: type of APH (abruption placenta, placenta previa, undetermined)
cohort: Fifty pregnant patients experiencing antepartum hemorrhage (APH) with a gestational age of 34 weeks or more.
finding: Antepartum hemorrhage (APH) is a primary cause of maternal and perinatal morbidity and mortality, with abruption placenta being the most frequent type and postpartum hemorrhage with blood transfusion and fetal low birth weight/preterm birth being prevalent complications.
mod_finding: Cesarean section was the most commonly used mode of delivery (82%) among patients with APH.
cross-section timing: During a 5-month period from December 2022 to April 2023
